mechanisms.A: Theta transformation laws fix the additive constant, division identities control the norm, and the local-height product formula fixes its arithmetic normalization.
mechanisms.B: Integral centralizers, finite norm maps and cusp winding determine the parameter equivalence, while the marked reflection and cap-meridian maps determine the real forms.
mechanisms.C: The integral congruence kernel determines the parabolic quotient, and the wedge equation with its Hermitian form determines the fibre strata.
mechanisms.D: Root characters and logarithmic residues compute the connecting scalar and direct images, exterior quotients by $dt$ give the ordinary modules, and theta factors with cusp Cartier frames give the coefficient cocycles.
mechanisms.E: Weighted section counts and local Koszul modules compute every Picard twist, while the nonzero Kodaira--Spencer class gives the coordinate on the Kuranishi line.
mechanisms.F: The intrinsic canonical system recovers the marked base, finite-orbit vanishing kills horizontal meridians, and their constant ratio across the connected compact corner contradicts the nonzero cusp coefficient.
mechanisms.G: The intrinsic Albanese invariant detects the outer boundary, and the exact dual-period equations with their quadratic cancellation determine nonseparation and every marked closed-group limit.

statuses.A: New period evaluations, norm values and level classification, using the elliptic section of \cite[Remark~3.12, p.~19]{AC2026}.
statuses.B: New classification for the displayed discrete data and real forms; the standard $2\mathbb Z$ equivalence is known \cite[Theorem~1.4, p.~3]{DuEtAl2026v1}.
statuses.C: New integral monodromy and maximal proper domain, answering \cite[Remark~8.4, pp.~23--24]{Engel2026}.
statuses.D: New evaluated cohomology and coefficient atlas; the ordinary-module calculation corrects \cite[Remark~9.21, p.~81]{AC2026}.
statuses.E: New all-twist and higher-multiplicity formulas; the standard untwisted deformation results are known \cite[Theorem~6.12, pp.~81--82; Proposition~6.16, p.~85]{DuEtAl2026v1}.
statuses.F: New filling obstruction and untwisted plumbing; the Euler calculation corrects the proposed central model in \cite[Conjecture~8.2, p.~22]{Engel2026}.
statuses.G: New boundary obstruction and marked limit formulas, using the annihilator duality of \cite[Theorem~3.1, p.~2017]{Cornulier2011}.

known_new_rows.A: New explicit evaluations and sharp norm bounds from the known section \cite[Remark~3.12, p.~19]{AC2026}; the quotient and height inputs are \cite[Definition~2.3, p.~5; proof of Lemma~2.1, pp.~3--4]{Engel2026}, transported by \cref{I:weierstrass-comparison}.
known_new_rows.B: New discrete-data and real-form extensions of the standard equivalence \cite[Theorem~1.4, p.~3]{DuEtAl2026v1}; the higher construction is \cite[Theorem~1.1, p.~1; Section~2.1, pp.~4--6]{ViaclovskyLog2026}, with $(k,l)=(1,1)$ giving the standard data.
known_new_rows.C: New exact group, quotient and proper-domain answer to \cite[Remark~8.4, pp.~23--24]{Engel2026}; the fibre tests use the integral wedge equation of \cite[Lemma~9.2, p.~65]{AC2026} with the period row $\beta=\beta_c$.
known_new_rows.D: New value of the Hodge integer, full cohomology and coefficient representatives extending \cite[Theorem~9.1(vi), p.~65; Proposition~9.20, p.~80]{AC2026}; the degree-one cusp module corrects its Remark~9.21, p.~81, and specifies the degree dependence of Remark~1.3, p.~5.
known_new_rows.E: New Picard-twist and coprime-root calculations extending the known standard tangent, Kuranishi and automorphism results \cite[Theorems~1.3--1.4, p.~3; Theorem~6.12, pp.~81--82; Proposition~6.16, p.~85; Theorem~7.14, p.~95]{DuEtAl2026v1}, under the parameter map of \cref{night:P5.7}.
known_new_rows.F: New marked nonfilling obstruction and explicit untwisted filling in the degeneration setting of \cite[Remark~8.1, p.~22]{Engel2026}; virtual Euler number zero excludes the particular central model in its Conjecture~8.2, p.~22.
known_new_rows.G: New intrinsic boundary and marked additive-limit calculations; the map $w\mapsto iw/216$ supplies the modular boundary, and \cite[Theorem~3.1, p.~2017]{Cornulier2011} supplies closed-group duality under the real annihilator map.
